import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
sha=lambda path:hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
manifest_path=root/'dist/native-match-core-browser.js.inputs.json'
manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
html=root/'../../outputs/ばせぼーるlv46_TBD_vs_LAD_走塁と守備AI改善版.html'
metadata=json.loads(pathlib.Path(str(html)+'.build.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
mismatches=[path for path,expected in manifest['inputs'].items() if sha(root/path)!=expected]
bundle_sha=sha(root/'dist/native-match-core-browser.js')
checks={'inputCount':len(manifest['inputs']),'sourceMismatches':mismatches,'bundleEntryMatches':bundle_sha==manifest['entrySha256'],'htmlBundleMatches':bundle_sha==metadata['nativeBundleSha256'],'htmlManifestMatches':sha(manifest_path)==metadata['bundleInputManifestSha256'],'htmlFileMatches':sha(html)==metadata['sha256'],'rosterMatches':sha(root/'docs/demos/live-game-roster-v2.json')==metadata['physicalRosterSha256'],'catalogMatches':sha(root/'docs/demos/live-game-roster-catalog-v2.json')==metadata['physicalCatalogSha256'],'bundleSha256':bundle_sha,'manifestSha256':sha(manifest_path)}
print(json.dumps(checks,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if checks['inputCount']==105 and not mismatches and all(checks[key] for key in ['bundleEntryMatches','htmlBundleMatches','htmlManifestMatches','htmlFileMatches','rosterMatches','catalogMatches']) else 1)
